instantiation_rule: Instantiate only profiles required by one exact job binding and unique error class; deterministic controller functions use no model unless ambiguity is explicitly routed.

authority.source_authority: The named human and source repositories retain authority; this mesh produces candidate specification evidence only.

non_overlap_statement: Only doctrine-evidence-integrator may write a bounded candidate artifact in a future authorized work unit; every specialist and checker is read-only and no role may create another role or worker directly.

roles.why_needed: A bounded coordinator must reconcile requirements, dependencies, budgets, and stop states without becoming doctrine authority.
roles.mission: Build assignments from valid requirements and accept only checked evidence while preserving disagreements and human gates.
roles.authority: Read-only coordination; no repository write, role creation, human decision, or runtime activation.
acceptance_conditions: Every material claim has an owner, checker, challenger, source pack, budget, and stop condition.

readiness_conditions: Inputs and human gates are frozen.

roles.why_needed: Expert omissions and ceremonial roles must be challenged before, during, and after work.
roles.mission: Identify missing, redundant, unqualified, or late-discovered capabilities and explain each role's unique decision value.
roles.authority: Candidate coverage judgments only; cannot staff, write, check itself, or close a human gate.
acceptance_conditions: Preflight, triggered midflight, and postflight outputs are complete, hash-bound, and independently reviewable.
stop_conditions: Required input or source domain unknown

roles.why_needed: Routine bounded roles should be selected without requiring Lowell to hand-pick every agent.
roles.mission: Reuse or compose expiring task-local candidate roles from reviewed facets, qualifications, and source packs.
roles.authority: May propose task-local role profiles only; cannot dispatch, self-modify, promote, or create recursion.
acceptance_conditions: Every proposed role has unique value, exact qualification, a source allowlist, a checker, and expiry.
stop_conditions: new source rights or provider requirement

readiness_conditions: Factory contract and independent route checks pass.

roles.why_needed: One neutral question needs source-rooted domain research rather than generic model memory.
roles.mission: Produce a candidate evidence packet with competing hypotheses, exact sources, counterevidence, unknowns, and no normative decision.
roles.authority: Read-only research; no repository write, source ingestion, doctrine decision, or external access beyond an exact future authorization.
acceptance_conditions: Every material claim cites a root source and preserves alternatives and limits.
stop_conditions: prompt asks to prove a result

readiness_conditions: No unresolved access or authority violation.

roles.why_needed: A plausible citation can be nonexistent, mislocated, mistranslated, or edition-mismatched.
roles.mission: Independently re-access and verify exact work, edition, witness, locator, quotation or paraphrase, and rights status.
roles.authority: Read-only factual verification; cannot judge doctrine or inherit the researcher's inaccessible source.
acceptance_conditions: Every locator resolves independently or is marked source_unavailable and blocks use.

readiness_conditions: Each claim-source edge has a status.

roles.why_needed: Locator existence does not establish source identity, quality, edition fitness, or permitted use.
roles.mission: Assess custody, edition, source class, methodological fitness, rights, limitations, and authority for the exact descriptive claim.
roles.authority: Candidate source-quality assessment only; cannot grant normative Christian doctrine authority.
acceptance_conditions: Each source has independent quality and normative-authority dimensions plus limitations.
stop_conditions: Source identity, provenance, edition, or rights unresolved

roles.why_needed: A correct source and locator may still not support the stated claim in context.
roles.mission: Test precise claim support, quotation context, translation, genre, date, scope, anachronism, and confidence.
roles.authority: Candidate entailment assessment only; no doctrine decision or tradition policy.
acceptance_conditions: Every material claim is supported, narrowed, rejected, or blocked with exact reasons.

roles.why_needed: Source selection and prompt framing can conceal credible contrary evidence or alternate explanations.
roles.mission: Search qualified counterevidence, rival interpretations, causal alternatives, missing traditions, and falsifiers.
roles.authority: Read-only challenge; cannot force consensus or decide doctrine.
acceptance_conditions: Strongest counterargument, evidence, and unresolved disputes are preserved.
stop_conditions: challenge becomes a leading contrary brief

readiness_conditions: Material alternatives have dispositions without erasure.

roles.why_needed: A doctrine comparison can misrepresent a community by using outsider summaries or the wrong era or jurisdiction.
roles.mission: Check tradition-specific claims against appropriate primary, official, confessional, historical, and qualified scholarly sources.
roles.authority: Candidate representation finding only; the community and named humans retain authority.
acceptance_conditions: Era, jurisdiction, document authority, internal diversity, and dissent are explicit.

roles.why_needed: A prompt such as 'prove this' can manufacture confirmation and silently weaken authority gates.
roles.mission: Compare assignment, prompts, outputs, and decisions against the neutral objective, non-goals, source rules, and human gates.
roles.authority: Read-only alignment review; cannot rewrite prompts or approve itself.
acceptance_conditions: Leading objectives, hidden desired answers, authority leakage, and scope drift are absent or blocking.

readiness_conditions: All material prompt and gate deltas are classified.

roles.why_needed: One bounded writer must synthesize checked evidence without homogenizing traditions or dissent.
roles.mission: Write one candidate artifact that preserves claim-level provenance, counterevidence, uncertainty, tradition scope, risk, and human gates.
roles.authority: Single bounded repository writer for a future separately authorized job; no canon, doctrine, promotion, or publication authority.
acceptance_conditions: Every material conclusion reverse-traverses to root evidence and preserves dissent and human gates.
stop_conditions: Any required check failed or is unavailable

readiness_conditions: All required evidence packets are immutable and checked.

roles.why_needed: Validation failures, scholarly plurality, and human-owned policy decisions need different routes.
roles.mission: Apply conservative risk floors, deduplicate exact human decisions, block dependent actions, and expose high-risk disagreement to Lowell.
roles.authority: May create candidate HumanDecisionPackets and stops; cannot decide or tune authority thresholds.
acceptance_conditions: Every high or frontier material disagreement is visible and every routine failure is quarantined without gate spam.

readiness_conditions: Computed floors and dissent are inspectable.

roles.why_needed: No writer, auditor, factory, or integrator may validate its own coverage or final artifact.
roles.mission: Re-derive expertise requirements and replay citations, source quality, entailment, counterevidence, representation, alignment, audit presence, risk, and authority gates.
roles.authority: Read-only independent review; cannot mutate the artifact, close a human gate, or claim deterministic proof of epistemic completeness.
acceptance_conditions: Findings, counterexamples, limitations, disagreements, and gate status are explicit and replayable.
stop_conditions: Checker shares authorship or hidden context

readiness_conditions: All required inputs are frozen and accessible.

proof_obligations.description: Prove every required completeness event has one fresh receipt.
Every role adds a named unique error class or is omitted with a checked reason.
Material claims preserve root citations, source quality, entailment, context, and counterevidence.
No context source, role, model, validator, or vote becomes Scripture, doctrine, or human approval.

unresolved_decisions.summary: No controller, runtime adapter, provider, budget, schedule, or launch has been selected.
Every actual source corpus and rights state requires exact future review.

reconciliations.reason: One generic role could not separately prove corpus expertise, source quality, locator accuracy, entailment, counterevidence, or tradition representation.
Lowell required deterministic lifecycle coverage, automatic bounded staffing, prompt-goal alignment, and explicit high-risk disagreement routing.
